brief.headline: Cut the measuring-cup price from ₹0.38 to ₹0.35/piece (Premier Plastic's level) and move payment to 30 days to free up ₹10.19 L cash for us

priceAsk.summary: Drop the measuring cup (MESU. CUP 30MM TRANS.PP 2.5/5/10ML) from ₹0.38/NOS to ₹0.35/NOS
priceAsk.basis: We already pay Premier Plastic ₹0.35/NOS for the same cup; Mars is 8.6% higher. The market ask for a 28 mm PP cap sits at ₹0.55–1.20/pc (typical ₹0.85–0.95), so our ₹0.35 ask for a simpler measuring cup is well inside market range and fair.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Shift from 45 days after receipt to 30 days
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Frees up ₹10.19 L cash for us

brief.financialLeverage: Mars Plastics publishes no financials, so we can't see their revenue, profit or how tight their cash is. Our ₹1.24 Cr annual spend is meaningful for a private converter, but without their numbers we must rely on our own purchase data and on lining up a credible second source. The fact that we have four strong alternates (Mold-Tek, Manjushree, Hitech, and Pearl Polymers) — plus six manufacturer leads to qualify — gives us room to push for the Premier Plastic benchmark and tighter payment terms.

evidence.point: We pay Premier Plastic ₹0.35/NOS for the same measuring cup; Mars charges ₹0.38/NOS
Closing that gap saves us ₹82500 a year
Moving payment from 45 days to 30 days frees up cash for us
The open-market asking price for a 28 mm PP cap is ₹0.55–1.20/piece (typical ₹0.85–0.95), so our ₹0.35 target for a measuring cup is well below market and reasonable
We spend ₹1.24 Cr a year with Mars — enough volume to expect the best price they can offer

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd (private, ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health B 65/100)
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter covering pharma bottles, caps and preforms — a top second-source candidate already flagged for packaging

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd (listed, ₹1010.97 Cr revenue, health B 73/100)
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader in pails, containers and pharma packaging — strong, profitable and a robust alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited (manufacturer, India-Pan — a lead to qualify; verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Pan-India maker of plastic resins and packaging; strong upstream capability if we want direct sourcing

risks: Mars publishes no financials, so we can't gauge how much pressure they can take — keep the tone firm but not aggressive until we qualify a second source
We have no other current supplier for rigid plastic packaging besides Mars, so moving volume takes time; start qualifying Manjushree or Mold-Tek now to avoid being locked in
The six manufacturer leads (Reliance, Srichakra, IVL Dhunseri, Dalmia, Ganesha, Chemco) are unverified — treat them as prospects to investigate, not ready backups
If Mars pushes back hard on price, offer faster payment (15 days sooner frees ₹5.10 L for us) as a trade only if they meet the ₹0.35/NOS target
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to align your measuring-cup price to the ₹0.35/piece we pay Premier Plastic and move to 30-day payment — that puts us both on a sustainable footing and frees up working cash for our business.
